summaries.1: Security Common Criteria CC1–CC9 (control environment through risk mitigation) — usual core of every SOC 2.
summaries.2: Availability A1 — optional TSC category for system availability commitments.
summaries.3: Confidentiality C1 — optional TSC category for information designated confidential.
summaries.4: Processing Integrity PI1 — optional TSC category for complete, valid, accurate, timely, authorized processing.
summaries.5: Privacy P1–P8 — optional TSC Privacy criteria (notice through monitoring); not the EU GDPR.
